header.logo: "HARDIK BHANSALI" en texto, con bio corta debajo ("digital experience designer who can lucid dream design concepts...")

main.section: Escena WebGL con animación "pinned" por scroll: "THE WORLD WITNESSED THE BIRTH OF a designer..." + fecha "22.09.2000", con badges de Webby/FWA/Awwwards superpuestos
Tagline "Born in the age of machines, to serve the world with digital design" + 3 testimonios en audio (CEO de Awwwards, colega de diseño, VP de WIX)

Declaración de identidad: "He never thought of being a designer / he was always destined to be one"
Logros: "45 websites design awwwards" y "founded LUCERRÁ studio"
"A peek into Hardik's personal life": música favorita (Raam katha/bhajan) y videojuegos favoritos (Black Myth Wukong, Super Mario Bros., Mortal Kombat 1, Contra)
